description: Work backwards from a target take-home to the gross salary that produces it, under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 (2026 tax year). This is the question employers and contractors actually ask — "what must I pay for them to clear ₦500,000 a month" — and it cannot be answered by applying a rate, because PAYE is banded. Returns the required gross with the full band-by-band working and the statutory source. Informational only — verify with the tax authority. Interactive version: https://zaleso.com/ng/net-salary

includeNhf.description: Deduct the 2.5% National Housing Fund contribution — voluntary for private-sector employees since 2023. Default false.

includePension.description: Deduct the 8% employee pension contribution (PRA 2014). Default true.

period.description: Whether takeHome is monthly or annual. Default monthly.

rentPaidAnnual.description: Annual rent actually paid, in naira. Unlocks rent relief (20% of rent, capped at ₦500,000).

takeHome.description: Target take-home (net) pay in naira, after PAYE and deductions.

name: ng_gross_for_take_home
title: Nigeria gross-up (salary for a target take-home)
